title: Internal forms have a deadline, a count and an email reminder
description: Fill a form in the sidebar now shows how many forms are waiting for your answer. Whoever runs an internal form can give it a deadline, and everyone it is for gets an email when it goes live and again as the deadline gets close.
items: Set the deadline on the form's Settings tab. It is optional, and after that day the form stops taking answers
The first email goes out within about an hour of publishing. Reminders go three days before the deadline and the day before, only to people who have not answered
Who gets these emails can be changed under Admin settings, in the Internal forms section
pending: Needs its database update: paste supabase/migrations/20261103090000_p17_10_form_reminder_type.sql into the Supabase SQL editor, then 20261103090100_p17_10_internal_form_deadline.sql. Until then there is no count, no deadline control and no email.
